=== EMISSION ORDER ===
Pattern mirrors FontAsset pattern exactly:
  Backboard → ImageAsset → FileAssetContents → Artboard → Image(drawable) → …

=== ASSET REFERENCE MECHANISM ===
Image.assetId (key 206) uses 0-based indexing among ImageAsset objects in the
global object stream. Unlike artboard-relative parentId, this counts only
ImageAsset objects in order of appearance in the stream.

Example: if there is 1 ImageAsset at global index [1], then Image.assetId=0
references it. This parallels TextStylePaint.fontAssetId (key 279) which also
uses 0-based asset indexing among FontAsset objects.

=== KEY DISTINCTIONS from FontAsset ===
- FontAsset typeKey=141, ImageAsset typeKey=105
- FontAsset.fontAssetId ref key on TextStyle = 279
  ImageAsset.assetId ref key on Image        = 206
- Both use FileAssetContents (typeKey=106) for embedded bytes (key 212)
- Both use key 203 (name) and key 204 (assetId/cloud-id) on the asset object
